description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and constants used internally in PySpark, including traceback handling, socket connection management, thread classes, and evaluation type definitions.

classes.name: VersionUtils
classes.description: Provides utility methods to parse Spark version strings.

classes.name: InheritableThread
classes.description: Thread class that inherits JVM thread properties for PySpark, supporting Spark Connect.

classes.name: _FaulthandlerHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage Python fault handling, including enabling, disabling, and periodic dump of tracebacks.

methods.name: print_exec
methods.description: Prints the current exception traceback to a given stream.

methods.name: majorMinorVersion
methods.description: Extracts major and minor version numbers from a Spark version string.

methods.name: fail_on_stopiteration
methods.description: Decorator that raises a RuntimeError instead of StopIteration.

methods.name: walk_tb
methods.description: Generator that yields traceback objects from a traceback chain.

methods.name: try_simplify_traceback
methods.description: Simplifies traceback by removing frames from the current package.

methods.name: local_connect_and_auth
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to local host with optional authentication.

methods.name: _do_server_auth
methods.description: Performs authentication protocol over a socket connection.

methods.name: is_remote_only
methods.description: Checks if the environment is only for Spark Connect (no RDD API).

methods.name: spark_connect_mode
methods.description: Returns environment variable indicating Spark connect mode.

methods.name: default_api_mode
methods.description: Returns the default API mode based on Spark connect mode.

methods.name: with_faulthandler
methods.description: Decorator to enable fault handler during function execution.

methods.name: start_faulthandler_periodic_traceback
methods.description: Starts periodic traceback dump for fault handler.
